note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- Transcript: the complete dialogue between the doctor and patient (as plain text).
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx): the DDx JSON you referenced (exact content).

Once I have those, I will produce:
- Subjective: presenting complaint details, onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, social history.
- Objective: relevant physical findings and any exam details from the transcript (and any stated vitals if present).
- Assessment & Plan: structured by issue(s) with:
  - Issue name
  - Likely diagnosis
  - Consistent DDx items (with likelihood tags if available)
  - Investigations planned
  - Treatments planned
  - Referrals (if applicable)
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, any internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”), and any commentary on the transcript quality.

Notes:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx to enrich reasoning only when consistent with the transcript. If conflicts arise, I will include both statements and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will use American English, concise professional tone, and avoid adding information not present in the transcript or DDx (e.g., vitals or details not stated).

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON here.
